about: Figures cut from the reference sheets for tools/art/meshy_unit.py. sheet is the original in the user's Downloads (the crop Meshy saw is kept beside each model as reference.png); box is [left, top, right, bottom] in sheet pixels. role picks the library clips. gameHeight is the model height in authored units before AlphaWorldArt.UnitScale, weapons included, matched to the figures it replaces. teamHues are the cloth hues, in degrees, that take the owner's colour.

concept.prompt: Same painted 3D game-art style, same kingdom culture and the same blue-and-cream tabard with a gold fleur-de-lis as these two figures: a medieval longbowman in a padded gambeson and a simple steel kettle hat, a longbow and a quiver of arrows slung on his back.

Same rendering style, same green-skinned orc people and the same crude leather, bone and iron gear as these figures: a wiry orc labourer with a leather apron and rope belt, a heavy pickaxe and a wicker basket strapped on his back.

Same rendering style, same green-skinned orc people and the same crude leather, bone and iron gear as this warrior: a lean orc hunter in fur and leather, a crude horn recurve bow and a quiver of black-fletched arrows slung on his back.

Same painted 3D game-art style and the same elven people as these two figures: an elven forester in a short green leaf-trimmed tunic with a royal blue sash, a small curved hatchet on the belt and a woven basket on the back.

Same painted 3D game-art style and the same dwarf clan, with the same riveted bronze-and-steel plates and a crimson red tabard with gold runes, as these two figures: a stout dwarf crossbowman with a braided beard and an iron helm, a heavy steel crossbow and a bolt case slung on his back.

Same painted 3D game-art style, same kingdom culture and the same blue-and-cream tabard with a gold fleur-de-lis as these two figures: a travelling quartermaster in a padded coat and a soft blue cap, a tall wooden A-frame pack of lashed bundles and rolled cloth on his back with a small blue pennant on top, a coil of rope and a ledger case on his belt.

Same painted 3D game-art style and the same elven forest culture as these two figures: a tall walking tree guardian, a treant with a humanlike body of thick bark, two sturdy legs like roots and two long branch arms, a crown of chunky leaf clumps on its head, moss on the shoulders, pale glowing blue rune marks on the bark and royal blue cloth ribbons tied around its arms. Arms held well clear of the body.
